headline: Record quarter, strong bookings, guidance raised
summary_short: Revenue rose 8.0% to $4,428M and adjusted EPS grew 11.3% to $3.34. R&D Solutions net new bookings were $3.2B (book-to-bill 1.2x) and full-year guidance was raised.
summary_long: Commercial Solutions revenue grew 6.9% to $1,789M and R&D Solutions 8.7% to $2,639M. R&DS contracted backlog was $32.6B after a roughly $2.1B adjustment for inactive trials, with about $9.4B expected to convert in the next twelve months. Free cash flow was 120% of adjusted net income. New full-year guidance: revenue $17,350M-$17,500M, Adjusted EBITDA $4,025M-$4,055M and adjusted EPS $12.90-$13.00. Net leverage was 3.45x.
confidence_notes: Adjusted measures are non-GAAP. Segments were recast effective January 1, 2026. The backlog adjustment of about $2.1B has no impact on historical results, 2026 guidance, book-to-bill or next-twelve-month revenue from backlog, per the release.

drivers.explanation: Commercial Solutions grew 6.9% and R&D Solutions 8.7%; the CEO cites favorable demand indicators and organic growth acceleration in both businesses.
Higher win rates produced the strongest clinical quarterly bookings since 2022, per the CEO.
Management cites margin expansion, strong free cash flow and increased adoption of AI-powered solutions, with over 400 AI agents deployed.
